messages:
maria: heads-up: ran into a reproducible ordering glitch when a streaming conn idles ~4-6s and the gateway hands off to another proxy. not resume token related. trace=tr_7ac9 (link)
ajay: paste the minimal repro please?
maria: steps: open stream -> pause network for ~5s -> new proxy takes lease -> client sees two partial chunks swapped.
charlie: are seq nums per-connection or per-logical-stream?
maria: per-connection. when lease moves we restart seq space which downstream currently uses to order.
ajay: so two different proxies can emit the same seq numbers which confuses the merger. bad.
lin: what about a stream epoch header bound to the logical stream id? X-Stream-Epoch: <int>. increment on each lease transfer. downstream orders by (stream_id, epoch, seq).
charlie: that requires every proxy and the merge layer to be epoch-aware. also need to decide how to handle in-flight late frames from old epoch.
maria: proposal sketch: - introduce X-Stream-Epoch header - handoff control message includes last_ack_offset and proposed_epoch - new proxy only accepts frames with epoch >= proposed_epoch - older epochs are drop-or-logged
ajay: addendum: runtime exposes last_ack_offset so the new proxy can request replay from upstream only when safe. the upstream decides whether replay is allowed based on last_ack and side-effect flags.
lin: replay permission is the crux. for side-effect-free streams we can replay; for function-calls or tool invocations we must avoid duplication. default to "resume-only" (no replay) and have opt-in replay for safe streams.
charlie: alternative: block transfer until all outstanding frames ack. simpler correctness but can spike eviction tail latency (bad for autoscaling).
maria: tradeoffs: resume-only keeps correctness for side-effects but may increase failed handoffs. allowing replay improves availability but needs idempotency keys and stronger coordination.
ajay: we already have an idempotency header for non-streaming requests. could extend its semantics to tie to stream_epoch to reduce schema churn.
lin: also need a short buffer window at the merge layer to absorb minor reordering during epoch flip. say 50-200ms buffer tradeoff for latency vs correctness.
charlie: observability: track epoch_increment_count, replay_attempts, epoch_mismatch_drops, handoff_block_time. console should warn when a live stream had epoch bumped.
maria: ops concerns: customers will freak if function calls double-run. so ensure function-calls are marked side-effecting by default and replay path requires explicit consent. apps-bot: reminder: function-call messages default to side-effecting unless client marks safe.
ajay: proto sketch for handoff control: { lease_id, stream_id, last_ack_offset, proposed_epoch, allow_replay_flag } (we'll formalize).
charlie: think about using monotonic global stream ids instead of epoch to avoid coordinating increments. downside: requires global allocation or a strong-lease token generator. more complex.
lin: I'll prototype minimal gateway + merge changes in staging and run the reproduce script across a few ingress regions.
maria: I'll write an RFC draft that includes the trace, repro steps, proto sketch, and the two paths (block-transfer vs epoch+replay). target: RFC tomorrow morning.
ajay: I'll add runtime hooks to publish last_ack_offset and an API for upstream to accept replay.
charlie: I'll review the doc and run DB impact assessment for idempotency header extension.
ops-bot: deploy queued: staging/gateway candidate at 2026-03-21T15:42:00Z
maria: thanks all, filing draft now and will @channel when it's ready.
